notes: Ran Servers 2, 6 and 7 about 19 times and took Bank Job's 0-credit replacement every time instead of accessing, so two Project Beales were never stolen. Spent long stretches clicking for credits with cards in hand and sat broke at 0-3 credits for much of the game.

Built a big economy with Restructure and Celebrity Gift, then scored steadily out of a remote with two ice. Scoring was a bit slow for a Runner who never ran after turn 4, and the Marcus Batty install in Archives was odd.

Installed Atman with 0 counters, made some early R&D runs, then clicked for credits for nine straight turns up to 35 credits without running. The Corp advanced and scored Oaktown, Geothermal Fracking and Project Atlas uncontested.

Left R&D with no ice for eight turns while the Runner ran it four times a turn, and lost Global Food Initiative and Breaking News there. Otherwise it scored Beales efficiently, used Sensie and campaigns well, and closed with SanSan, but it never punished the 4 tags from Hard-Hitting News.

Strong start to 6 points, then facechecked R&D when Merlin had been revealed in HQ, losing Corroder and four cards, and later kept running into rezzed Merlin with no breaker. Made dozens of redundant HQ runs and Security Testing with no target, and never contested the remote while the Corp scored its last 5 points there.

From turn 7 it mostly clicked for credits and discarded every turn, hoarding up to 27 credits and almost never installing ice or agendas. R&D kept a single Archangel while the Runner ran it every turn and eventually stole four agendas, and the two Hard-Hitting News tag windows went unused.

Won with a sensible Sneakdoor Beta plan against HQ and trashed economy assets well. Early tempo was poor, with turns of clicking credits and Turning Wheel bounces, and it facechecked Gatekeepers with no breaker.

Ran R&D four times a turn while accessing the same top card, Cyberdex, each time, then clicked for credits for 14 turns up to 56 credits without running. The Corp scored Oaktown twice and other agendas from its remote uncontested.

Won quickly by scoring four agendas out of one remote behind Tollbooth, with good advancement timing. Spent Biotic Labor's extra clicks on draw and credit clicks, and lost an NAPD Contract through an HQ ice it left unrezzed.

Made a nice Biotic Labor fast-advance of Project Beale and won quickly, but left R&D with no ice for four turns of R&D runs. Wasted the turn-1 Biotic Labor and put NAPD Contract behind one ice it could not rez, which only worked because the Runner declined to steal.

Scored early, then spent about 15 turns advancing HQ ice, playing Building Blocks and making econ plays while barely installing agendas against a Runner who never ran. One turn used a single click and passed. It won only on a late Chiyashi flatline.

Reinstalled Chameleon over and over and let it bounce unused at end of turn. After Archer trashed its breakers it ran into rezzed Enigma on HQ about five times with no decoder, and it never pressured the remote where the Corp scored its final agendas.

Used Blue Sun to bounce Mausolus off the remote on the same turn it installed a 3-point SDS there, which the Runner stole, and twice spent 5 credits on Building Blocks for Border Control only to bounce it back. It clicked for credits while rich, and its churning ice let R&D give up the winning SSL Endorsement.

Ran unprotected R&D four times a turn but saw only the top card each time, never installed a card from a full grip, and then clicked for credits up to 26. It never boosted link against the remote's lone Resistor, so agendas sat in that remote for turns and were scored.
Kept steady R&D pressure with Temujin, Indexing and Ghost Runner and won through two Closed Accounts. Minor oddities were idle Archives runs and leaving tags on against a rich Corp.

Spent nearly every turn from turn 4 to 18 clicking for credits and discarding, peaking near 30 credits, with only Pop-up Window on R&D while the Runner raided it. It spent three clicks trashing Daily Casts repeatedly, never punished tags, and installed its first agenda on turn 19.

Had a good Oaktown steal through three ice, but its economy stayed broken near 0 credits for most of the game. It paid to install Chameleon at end of turn where it just bounced, and ran HQ into Archer that the Corp could rez by forfeiting an agenda, losing Atman and Cache.

Built a four-ice remote and then never installed an agenda in it. It clicked for credits and discarded every turn up to 64 credits while the Runner stole agendas from HQ and R&D, which had one ice each.

Scored Global Food Initiative early behind Resistor, ran a strong Sensie draw engine, and finished with a SanSan City Grid Breaking News score. It left an agenda behind only Resistor against a rich Runner for a turn, and discarded heavily.

Made repeated HQ runs that saw the same one or two cards and burned all its credits doing it. It then clicked for credits for six turns with a full grip and never contested Servers 2 and 3 while two Global Food Initiatives were advanced and scored.
